rust_summary: a server's levels opening and closing (`native_level_load`, `native_level_unload`).
doc_summary: a server's levels opening and closing, on the single player server thread and on a dedicated server: `native_level_load(dimension)` when a level opens, before any of its chunks (NeoForge's `LevelEvent.Load`), and `native_level_unload(dimension)` once it has closed, after its last save (`LevelEvent.Unload`). The level the world opens in comes before `WorldOpenReady`; the Nether and the End open when someone first goes there and close after 300 ticks with nobody in them. Every level still open closes when the server stops, before `WorldCloseFinal`, or when its open or its loop fails, so each load has one unload. Bundles that use them need "hooks": @API:level_events@.
